one_sentence: This document catalogs 23 articles in Part XVI, each deriving theological truths from physical laws and mathematical structures.
executive_summary: This document is an index of 23 articles in the God Stories series (Part XVI) of the Theophysics Research Initiative. Each article claims that physical laws—such as the Second Law of Thermodynamics, quantum mechanics, and information theory—reveal specific theological truths, including the character of God, the nature of salvation, and the structure of the Trinity. The series argues that these truths are not metaphorical but mathematically derivable, forming a unified framework called theophysics. The conclusion is that physics and theology converge on a single coherent narrative, with implications for understanding reality, morality, and human purpose.
short_summary: This document is an index of 23 articles in the God Stories series (Part XVI). The core structural claim is that physical laws and mathematical structures directly encode theological truths. Key evidence includes derivations from the Second Law of Thermodynamics, quantum measurement, and information theory. This matters because it proposes a rigorous, testable framework unifying physics and theology.
